label: Date type spike
info: Spike: which date and time types does the parquet node write (legacy and modern engine)? Output in Sandbox/spike/ of the data lake. Delete the tab after the test.

name: [1] SPIKE: BUILD ROWS
info: STAGE 1 - one inject, one function that builds the legacy engine cases (numbers only: legacy reads text and Date objects as numbers); its last output starts the modern engine cases in the next lane. Each case has its own parquet node. Run once, then the result files in Sandbox/spike/ are read with pyarrow.

name: 1.1 Build legacy cases
[2] SPIKE: MODERN CASES
info: STAGE 2 - the last output of the legacy function starts this one: it builds the modern engine cases (day numbers, epoch ms, negative ms, Date objects, ISO text, BigInt, ms of a day).

name: 2.1 Build modern cases
[3] CASE legacy_date_day_number
info: STAGE 3 - engine parquetjs, column x of type DATE, value a day number. The result is Sandbox/spike/legacy_date_day_number.parquet; a failure gives legacy_date_day_number_ERROR.txt.

name: 3.1 Set spike path

info: STAGE 4 - engine parquetjs, column x of type TIMESTAMP_MILLIS, value epoch ms, 2026. The result is Sandbox/spike/legacy_timestamp_ms.parquet; a failure gives legacy_timestamp_ms_ERROR.txt.
